details.label: Discussion
details.text: Strong/severe thunderstorms continue in a west-east zone within a region of modest warm advection at 0645z. Earlier reports of measured severe gusts and damage have been received across western Kentucky. Latest mesoanalysis depicted moderate/strong elevated buoyancy and 35-45 kts of westerly effective shear, supporting continued updraft organization and severe potential. In the near-term, the increase in storm coverage observed on regional radars and related convective overturning should result in the severe potential focusing on southern portions of WW 602, while continuing across WW 603. A local watch extension in time may ultimately be necessary across southern portions of WW 602 prior to the scheduled 3 am CDT expiration
